rules.intent: Trigger an in-place action versus navigate to another location.
rules.rule: Use Button for actions. Use Link for navigation.

rules.intent: Collect free-form text versus choose from known values.
rules.rule: Use Input for free-form text, Select for a known non-editable option set, and Combobox when editable/searchable text is part of option selection.

rules.intent: Choose from a small option set that should remain visible.
rules.rule: Use Radio for form choice semantics. Use SegmentedButton for compact mutually exclusive view/action modes.

rules.intent: Arrange content vertically, horizontally, generically with flex, in two dimensions, overlapped, or positioned.
rules.rule: Prefer Column for vertical sequences, Row for horizontal sequences, Grid for two-dimensional layout, Stack for overlap, Absolute for positioned children, and Flex only when the axis is genuinely generic or dynamic.
Do not use View for normal application layout. View is the component-author primitive and the View documentation demo exception.

rules.intent: Render tabular data with or without data-grid behavior.
rules.rule: Use Table for semantic tabular composition. Use DataGrid when sorting, resizing, selection, or virtualization is required.

rules.intent: Choose between hint, anchored interactive surface, dialog, drawer, or menu.
rules.rule: Use ToolTip for brief non-interactive hints, Popover for anchored interactive content, Dialog for a focused dialog surface, Drawer for edge-attached panels, and Menu for command/menu navigation semantics.

rules.intent: Keep exiting content mounted while exit motion completes.
rules.rule: Use Presence for enter/exit mount lifecycle. Do not build a parallel exit-presence mechanism.

rules.intent: Associate labels, descriptions, errors, fields, fieldsets, and legends.
rules.rule: Use Weave form composition instead of manually duplicating label/description/error association logic.
